value.body: Central government bodies employ Ayush doctors as medical officers — for example in the Ayush wellness centres and dispensaries of the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS), and in Ayush units of some ESIC hospitals. Regular posts are filled through UPSC or the body's own recruitment; some posts are contractual. These are separate from state Ayush and NHM posts.

items.label: Eligible degrees
items.note: Must match the system named in the post

items.label: Recruiting bodies
items.value: UPSC (regular posts); ESIC and other bodies' own notices

items.label: Where you work
items.note: Mostly in cities with CGHS or ESIC coverage

items.label: Registered Ayush practitioners
items.note: Doctors across Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Sowa Rigpa and Homoeopathy
items.source: Rajya Sabha unstarred question 1923 (Ministry of Ayush), compiled from State/UT boards and councils

items.label: UPSC Medical Officer / Research Officer (Ayurveda) posts
items.note: One recruitment cycle; vacancy numbers change with each notice
items.source: UPSC recruitment (2020 cycle), Ministry of AYUSH — as reported in a UPSC addendum

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A recognised degree in the matching system, a completed internship and current registration with the central or a state register. Apply when UPSC or the employing body notifies posts; selection is usually by a recruitment test, an interview, or both. Age limits and any experience rule are set in each notification.

value.title: At a glance
items: Notifications are irregular, and the number of posts is small compared with state recruitment.
Some contractual posts are filled by walk-in interview rather than a written exam.
Applying to both central and state notifications widens the options.

value.title: Registered Ayush practitioners
value.note: Years are not evenly spaced. Counts come from State/UT boards and councils and may include inactive registrations; rounded to two decimals.
value.source: Lok Sabha reply 2018 (figure as on 01.01.2017) and Rajya Sabha reply, March 2025 (figures as on 01.01.2022 and 01.01.2023), Ministry of Ayush
